policy: Full observable twm parity may be claimed only when every final 1.0 release gate is passed with validated checked-in evidence.

gates.title: One hundred percent grammar coverage.
gates.pending_reason: No consolidated Milestone 10 grammar-coverage evidence report is checked in.

gates.title: One hundred percent built-in action coverage.
gates.pending_reason: No consolidated Milestone 10 built-in-action coverage evidence report is checked in.

gates.title: No “partial,” “parsed only,” or unexplained compatibility entries.
gates.pending_reason: The compatibility ledger has not been certified by a Milestone 10 closure report.

gates.title: Zero geometry differences in the canonical profile.
gates.pending_reason: No complete canonical-profile geometry certification report is checked in.

gates.title: Zero unexplained focus or stacking differences.
gates.pending_reason: No complete focus-and-stacking differential certification report is checked in.

gates.title: No unreviewed golden-image differences.
gates.pending_reason: No complete golden-image review report is checked in.

gates.title: Successful 72-hour soak testing.
gates.pending_reason: A continuous successful 72-hour soak has not been recorded as checked-in release evidence.

gates.title: Successful package tests on every supported distribution and architecture.
gates.pending_reason: Package lifecycle evidence is not complete for the full supported Debian 13 amd64 and arm64 matrix.

gates.title: Successful testing in nested, VM login, and physical hardware environments.
gates.pending_reason: Checked-in passing evidence is not available for all three required environment classes.

gates.title: Blind A/B evaluation by experienced `twm` users, with no repeatable distinguishing behavior in the canonical profile.
gates.pending_reason: No completed blind A/B evaluation by multiple experienced twm users is checked in.

gates.title: All unavoidable Wayland translations documented in the manual and compatibility ledger.
gates.pending_reason: No release-wide audit proves that every unavoidable translation is documented in both required locations.
